deterministic.proposal:
PROCEDURE close_open_emails_to(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND EMAIL WHERE SELF.WHO={person} STATUS=OPEN
FOR $v1 IN $v0 : SET_STATUS $v1 CLOSED
RETURN $v0
END
